NetWatch is a real-time network diagnostics tool that runs in the terminal. It provides instant visibility into network activity, decodes encrypted traffic, identifies processes behind connections, and detects potential threats like malware beaconing or data exfiltration over DNS. It aims to consolidate the functionality of bandwidth meters, Wireshark triage views, and intrusion detectors into a single, zero-configuration binary.
